points.K2: 头号准则：准备好滴定管
points.K6: 放到零附近，记初始液位

shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁架台旁，台上夹着滴定管，下面是锥形瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a ring stand holding a burette above a conical flask on a white base, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲酸碱滴定的规范操作。

shots.scene: 滴定管、指示剂滴瓶、淡粉色锥形瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a burette, a small dropper bottle, and a conical flask with very pale pink liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 备好管、认准色、慢慢滴。

shots.scene: 阿杰猛开活塞，锥形瓶里溶液变成深粉色，他一脸懊恼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens the burette stopcock wide and the liquid in the conical flask turns deep pink; he looks frustrated.
shots.narration: 阿杰一口气放液，颜色变得太深了。

shots.scene: 深粉色锥形瓶图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a conical flask with deep pink liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 滴过了终点，这次结果作废。

shots.scene: 小研指着一只几乎无色、只带淡粉的锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a conical flask with barely visible pale pink liquid.
shots.narration: 小研说：终点只要淡淡的一点粉。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods.
shots.narration: 我们从准备滴定管开始。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一瓶贴空白标签的溶液，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a bottle of clear solution with a blank label, a question mark floating beside it.
shots.narration: 这瓶溶液浓度是多少？

shots.scene: 标准溶液从滴定管滴入锥形瓶，颜色变化，箭头指向结果
shots.prompt_en: A standard solution drips from a burette into a conical flask, the color changes, and an arrow points to a blank result card. No people.
shots.narration: 用已知浓度的溶液滴定，就能算出来。

shots.section_title: 头号准则：准备好滴定管
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指，身旁是滴定管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger next to a burette on a stand.
shots.narration: 头号准则：先把滴定管准备好。
overlay: 头号准则：准备好滴定管

shots.section_title: 头号准则：准备好滴定管
shots.scene: 一本空白讲义翻到容量器具那一页
shots.prompt_en: A blank booklet open to a page with simple icons of a pipette, a flask and a burette. No people.
shots.narration: 详细方法，见容量器具那一课。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，一手扶着倾斜的滴定管，一手拿小烧杯直接倒入少量滴定液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, holds a tilted burette in one hand and pours a small amount of titrant into it directly from a small beaker.
shots.narration: 先加几毫升滴定液。

shots.scene: 滴定管倾斜转动，液体润湿内壁后从尖嘴放掉
shots.prompt_en: A burette held almost level is rotated so the liquid coats the wall, then drained from the tip into a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 倾斜转动润湿内壁，再全部放掉。

shots.scene: 液面装到零刻度以上
shots.prompt_en: The burette is filled so the liquid level is above the top mark. No people.
shots.narration: 装液到零刻度以上。

shots.scene: 小研把滴定管牢牢夹在铁架台的滴定管夹上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student firmly clamps the burette in a burette clamp on the ring stand.
shots.narration: 把滴定管牢牢夹在铁架台上。

shots.scene: 尖嘴里的气泡被放大镜圈出
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass highlights an air bubble in the burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 尖嘴有气泡，不能就这样开始。

shots.scene: 手指快速来回转动活塞，液体一股股流进烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Fingers quickly turn the stopcock back and forth, letting short spurts of liquid into a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 快速来回转动活塞，把气泡冲出去。

shots.section_title: 放到零附近，记初始液位
shots.scene: 液面降到零刻度附近停住
shots.prompt_en: The liquid level drops and stops near the top mark of the burette. No people.
shots.narration: 放到零刻度附近就可以。
overlay: 放到零附近，记初始液位

shots.section_title: 放到零附近，记初始液位
shots.scene: 时钟图标上一个小人反复调零的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person fiddling endlessly with a stopcock next to a clock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用花时间调到正好是零。

shots.section_title: 放到零附近，记初始液位
shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上写下初读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes the starting reading in a blank notebook beside the burette.
shots.narration: 关键是把初始读数记下来。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁，滴定管内壁的液膜慢慢流下
shots.prompt_en: Next to an hourglass icon, a thin film of liquid slowly runs down the inside wall of the burette. No people.
shots.narration: 静置约一分钟，让内壁的液体流下。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白卡片，上面画着一个问号和锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank card showing a conical flask icon and a question mark.
shots.narration: 正式滴定前，先来一次粗滴定。

shots.scene: 刻度上一个大致范围被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A burette scale with a rough range circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 看看终点大概在哪里。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶变成深粉色，旁边一个笑脸图标
shots.prompt_en: A conical flask turned deep pink, next to a relaxed smiley face icon. No people.
shots.narration: 粗滴定滴过头了？没关系。

shots.scene: 小研在记录本上写下大致用量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notes the approximate volume used in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 记下用量，正式滴定时心里有数。

shots.scene: 三只锥形瓶放在白纸上：无色、淡粉、深粉
shots.prompt_en: Three conical flasks on white paper: one colorless, one very pale pink, one deep pink. No people.
shots.narration: 三瓶对比，哪一瓶是终点？

shots.scene: 无色瓶旁出现加号，深粉瓶旁打叉
shots.prompt_en: The colorless flask gets a plus sign icon, the deep pink flask gets a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 无色还差碱，深粉加多了。

shots.scene: 中间的淡粉色瓶子打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The middle flask with barely visible pale pink liquid gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 澄清透亮、淡淡一点粉，正好。

shots.scene: 滴定管刻度，液面停在零刻度下方
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a burette scale with the liquid level a little below the top mark. No people.
shots.narration: 正式滴定，先记初读数。

shots.scene: 三个不同的起始液面图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three burette icons with different starting levels, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 从哪里开始都行，记清楚就好。

shots.scene: 小研拿着指示剂滴瓶向锥形瓶滴加
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, adds drops from a small dropper bottle into the conical flask.
shots.narration: 加指示剂，颜色变化才看得见。

shots.scene: 两滴液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two small drops falling into a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 一般一到两滴，按酸的种类定。

shots.scene: 液体从尖嘴连续流入锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Titrant flows steadily from the burette tip into the conical flask on a white base. No people.
shots.narration: 心里有数，开始可以滴得快些。

shots.scene: 小研一手控活塞，一手旋摇锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student controls the stopcock with one hand and swirls the conical flask with the other.
shots.narration: 每加一次，都要摇一摇。

shots.scene: 粉色在溶液中散开后消失
shots.prompt_en: A pink streak appears in the flask and fades away as the liquid is swirled. No people.
shots.narration: 粉色一摇就散，说明还没到终点。

shots.scene: 单个液滴慢慢从尖嘴落下
shots.prompt_en: A single drop slowly forms and falls from the burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 快到终点，就慢下来少量加。

shots.scene: 小研盯着锥形瓶的颜色，眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the color in the flask closely, with an eye icon beside her.
shots.narration: 一滴一滴加，紧盯颜色变化。

shots.scene: 半个液滴的图标与终点线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of half a drop next to a target line. No people.
shots.narration: 要在不到一滴之内到终点。

shots.scene: 手拿一支塑料吸头靠近滴定管尖嘴
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand brings a plastic pipette tip close to the burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 可以给尖嘴套一个塑料吸头。

shots.scene: 塑料吸头套在玻璃尖嘴上
shots.prompt_en: The plastic tip is pushed onto the glass burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 先把吸头套在尖嘴上。

shots.scene: 双手拉伸一条封口膜缠绕接口
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands stretch a strip of sealing film and wrap it around the joint. No people.
shots.narration: 封口膜要边拉伸边缠绕。

shots.scene: 撕断膜尾，手指轻拉检查
shots.prompt_en: The end of the film is torn off, and a finger gently tugs the tip to check it is firm. No people.
shots.narration: 撕断后检查，套得牢不松动。

shots.scene: 吸头里的小气泡被放大镜圈出
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass highlights a small bubble in the plastic tip. No people.
shots.narration: 装回去，先排掉吸头里的气泡。

shots.scene: 左边大液滴，右边小液滴，对比
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: a large drop from a glass tip on the left, a much smaller drop from a plastic tip on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 普通尖嘴液滴大，吸头的小得多。

shots.scene: 尖嘴挂着一滴液体
shots.prompt_en: A drop hangs from the burette tip above the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 以为到终点了？尖嘴还挂着一滴。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶内壁轻碰尖嘴，液滴沿瓶壁流下
shots.prompt_en: The inner wall of the conical flask touches the burette tip, and the drop runs down the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 用瓶内壁碰一下尖嘴，把它接下来。

shots.scene: 小研倾斜转动锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tilts and rotates the conical flask to wash down drops on the wall.
shots.narration: 再倾斜转动，冲下壁上的液滴。

shots.scene: 淡粉色锥形瓶在白纸上，旁边一个时钟
shots.prompt_en: A conical flask with barely visible pale pink liquid on white paper, a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 澄清、淡粉，而且颜色能保持。

shots.scene: 空气中的小分子图标飘入瓶口，粉色渐渐变淡
shots.prompt_en: Small gas molecule icons drift from the air into the flask, and the pale pink slowly fades. No people.
shots.narration: 终点颜色不是永久的。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，粉色消失
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to the flask, whose pink color has disappeared. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收空气里的二氧化碳，几分钟就褪。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁的滴定管
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to the burette on its stand. No people.
shots.narration: 收尾时，先静置一分钟。

shots.scene: 小研平视滴定管读数并记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the burette at eye level and writes in her notebook.
shots.narration: 平视读出终读数，记下来。

shots.scene: 两个读数图标相减得到结果
shots.prompt_en: Two blank reading cards with a minus sign between them and a result card. No people.
shots.narration: 初读数减去终读数，就是用量。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 书本和锥形瓶图标中间一个加号
shots.prompt_en: A book icon and a conical flask icon with a plus sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和操作，两样都要会。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现润洗、气泡、读数图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a rinsing burette, an air bubble and a notebook.
shots.narration: 润洗、夹牢、排气泡、记读数。

shots.scene: 粗滴定和淡粉色锥形瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rough trial flask and a pale pink conical flask with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 先粗后精，终点淡粉且持久。

shots.scene: 单个液滴和瓶壁接液图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a single drop and a flask wall touching a burette tip. No people.
shots.narration: 近终点逐滴加，半滴也要接。

shots.scene: 吸头和封口膜图标，旁边空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a plastic tip wrapped with film and a blank lab manual. No people.
shots.narration: 吸头让液滴更小，讲义也要读。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一只淡粉色锥形瓶，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a conical flask with pale pink liquid and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 一滴不多一滴不少，下次见！
